# JTS pull request review

Review changes against the JTS Brand System version pinned in AGENTS.md. Follow these repository instructions if the private source repository is unavailable.

- DOC-001: When behavior, settings, compatibility or recovery changes, check both the human guide and AI reference against the implementation. Check examples, defaults, errors and side effects. Flag material changes without paired documentation or a justified documentation-neutral exception in the PR.
- VIS-001 and VIS-002: Keep the approved light and dark publisher marks, distinct product hex, and accurate release status. Verify artwork provenance and flag unapproved changes to published branding or exports.
- HA-001 and HA-002: Check Home Assistant and Marketplace compatibility, and preserve the JTS - Dashboard Beam product identity. Check that verification claims distinguish CI from live Home Assistant tests.
- Report specific, actionable findings with the affected line and applicable standard. Use English for repository documentation and review findings.
